description: Requires a TechFabric engineer's Microsoft sign-in (scope blog.write). One question only the engineer can answer (what was measured, who it was for, what happened): asked in a form where the client shows one, or returned for you to ask in chat; call again with their answer, word for word. The answer is stored as one of the draft's sources, which the fact-check reads as their own words. Never answer it yourself.

answer.description: The engineer's answer, word for word, when you asked them in chat

passage.description: The sentence or section it is about, when there is one

question.description: One question only the engineer can answer, in plain words

name: ask_author
title: Ask you a question
